reference.title: The Use of Quartz as an Internal Pressure Standard in High-Pressure Crystallography

methods.source_location: Crichton–Ross p. 562 Experimental; p. 563 weighting paragraph
methods.notes: Quartz unit-cell volume with Angel et al. (1997); no paired quartz readings supplied.

recalculation.notes: Cannot independently recalculate pressures or original sigma_P from quartz volumes: paired marker measurements are absent. Do not reverse-generate them from tabulated P.

auxiliary_checks.notes: Ruby chip present; calibration version and measured shifts not reported. Ruby is not the quantitative Table 1 pressure scale.

assessment.basis: Agreement within the source's reported parameter error widths; this is not an inferred confidence convention.
qualifications: Fit parity within reported uncertainty on all 11 primary P-V rows. The largest weighted-refit coefficient shift is 0.123 reported error widths; maximum curve difference is 0.0096 GPa. Published coefficients are retained. Effective P/V variance assumes no covariance and omits the unreported ambient-pressure variance term while retaining its volume esd. Exact original workflow availability is a separate provenance note, not a failed-fit classification. See the [audit and residual plot](literature-reproductions/phase-e-crichton-ross-2000.md).

primary_source_check.finding: Publication-of-record PDF inspected in full, Table 1 checked visually. Published BM3 retained; source residual benchmarks reproduced and independent refits establish parity within reported uncertainty. Exact implementation provenance is separately documented and does not negate fit recovery.

primary_data_check.finding: All 11 P,a,c,V rows and every reported esd; absent ambient pressure esd is null. No original calibrant readings in source or publisher-listed supplements.

unresolved_issues: No atomic refinement for this exact Fe-bearing sample; position-only phase E indexing fallback.
Hydrogen inferred by analytical deficit; nominal six-O composition has uncertain charge closure.
scientific_validation.note: Published volume EOS successfully recovered: parity within reported uncertainty, with coefficient/curve differences documented. Original author-workflow provenance is assessed separately.
workflow_provenance_limitations: Original unrounded data, quartz readings, covariance, software/version, exact effective-error/weight iteration, and ambient-pressure error treatment absent. Author thesis Eq. 2.31 recovers pressure-residual WLS and reduced chi normalization, not the complete implementation.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Single-crystal hydrostatic compression of the measured Fe-bearing phase E sample; quartz experimental pressure scale.
parameter_provenance.V0: p. 563, Results: 105.627(7) conventional hexagonal-cell angstrom^3, freely refined; not the ambient Table 1 observation 105.633(16).
parameter_provenance.K0: p. 563: isothermal KT=92.9(7) GPa, freely refined.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: p. 563: 7.3(2), freely refined; not fixed to 4.
parameter_provenance.equation: Third-order Birch–Murnaghan with f=((V0/V)^(2/3)-1)/2, F=P/[3 f (1+2 f)^(5/2)] and F=K0[1+1.5(Kprime-4)f]; p. 563 F–f discussion.
parameter_provenance.errors: Parenthetical reported errors retained; confidence level and fitted covariance matrix are not supplied.
parameter_provenance.range: Table 1 exact extrema; room temperature reported qualitatively.
parameter_provenance.fit_objective: Author thesis (2000), Section 2.11, Eq. 2.31, p. 45: pressure-residual weighted least squares, chi_w_squared divided by n-m; pressure and propagated volume esds combined. Exact numerical implementation unresolved.
